flags.why: The alley sense is mainly Northern usage ([regional vocabulary reference](https://scr.vn/tieng-mien-bac.html)).
The dated tag incorrectly covers current breed usage such as mèo Xiêm ([current usage](https://mochicat.vn/cac-giong-meo-ba-tu/)).
flags.fix: Apply dated only to the country reference, not to Siamese breed names.

flags.why: The noun means a plant's leaf sheath, not a knife sheath ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%ADp)).
The example incorrectly uses bập for a knife sheath ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%ADp)).
flags.fix: Một bập dừa trôi trên sông. = A coconut leaf sheath floated on the river.

flags.why: Phụ cận is formal wording primarily used in written descriptions and administrative contexts ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/phu-can-euJSxbTOskfU6.html)).
